messages:
aj: Quick check — planning to enable the model_v6 rollout toggle tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Proposed global 5% with region overrides (EU 10%, APAC 1%). Any concerns?

maria: Looks fine from infra side. Autoscaling config tested for +5% RPS spike?

aj: autoscale policy reviewed, max pods +20% should absorb it. Prometheus alerts already in the playbook.

devon: Can we add a KV-cache warmup for the first 10k requests? v6 has a different tokenizer and misses cache hits currently.

aj: good call. I'll add a short warmup pre-rollout job.

lina: safety ask — add a quality guard to stop ramp if BLEU/ROUGE or our relevance score drops >2 points in 15m window.

aj: agreed. metric gate details below:
```
rollout_gates: {
  "latency_p50": {"threshold_ms": 300},
  "error_rate": {"threshold_pct": 0.5},
  "relevance_delta": {"threshold_points": -2, "window_min": 15}
}
```

maria: also ensure we route to fallback model on any 5xx spike. Is fallback auto-enabled?

deploy-bot: Heads-up: when flag flips, gradual ramp script will run: 5% -> 10% -> 25% over 4h. Fallback toggles available at `/ops/flags/model_v6/disable`.

aj: add me and @oncall-bot as kill-switch watchers. If gate trips, deployment should auto-disable and ping oncall.

oncall-bot: Noted. On-call rota notified for 09:00-13:00 UTC window. Will page if gates trip. :bell:

devon: One more — config snippet for the flag so infra can review before I merge the PR:
```json
{
  "name": "model_v6_canary",
  "enabled": false,
  "global_percent": 5,
  "overrides": {"eu": 10, "apac": 1},
  "stages": ["5m", "30m", "3h"],
  "kill_path": "/ops/flags/model_v6/disable"
}
```

maria: lgtm, will run a dry-run tomorrow 08:50 UTC to sanity-check metrics pipeline.

aj: thanks — plan: 08:50 dry-run, 09:00 flip to 5% (EU10/APAC1), monitor 2h, then continue ramp. If no objections I’ll schedule the PR merge and toggle.

lina: :thumbsup: one small ask — annotate the rollout in the incident channel when you flip. Keeps everyone aligned.

aj: will do. tagging this thread for audit.

maria: :ok_hand:

deploy-bot: Rollout script ready. Next action: aj merges PR and posts a short note when toggled.

aj: merging PR now. I’ll post a confirmation when the flag is live.

deploy-bot: Flag `model_v6_canary` set to enabled at 2001234567 by aj — initial percent: 5 (eu:10, apac:1). Gradual ramp schedule started.

aj: flag is live. Monitoring dashboards: https://dash.redwood.ai/model_v6/rollout — ping me if you see anything odd.

lina: copying the post into #incidents as requested. Good luck! :rocket:
